As Tower Semiconductor LTD (TSEM) Valuation Declined, Monarch Partners Asset Management Decreased by $2.04 Million Its Holding; As Ctrip Com Intl LTD (CTRP) Stock Value Declined, Parus Finance Uk LTD Raised Holding
June 17, 2018 - By Richard Conner
Parus Finance Uk Ltd increased its stake in Ctrip Com Intl Ltd (CTRP) by 28.79% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Parus Finance Uk Ltd bought 63,575 shares as the company’s stock declined 1.25% with the market. The institutional investor held 284,410 shares of the miscellaneous company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $13.26 million, up from 220,835 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Parus Finance Uk Ltd who had been investing in Ctrip Com Intl Ltd for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $28.20B market cap company. The stock increased 1.13% or $0.58 during the last trading session, reaching $51.72. About 4.27M shares traded. Ctrip.com International, Ltd. (NASDAQ:CTRP) has declined 16.53% since June 17, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 29.10% the S&P500. The institutional investor held 533,570 shares of the semiconductors company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $14.36M, down from 611,935 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Monarch Partners Asset Management Llc who had been investing in Tower Semiconductor Ltd for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $2.36B market cap company. It also reduced its holding in Paypal Hldgs Inc by 50,900 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 172,100 shares, and cut its stake in Alphabet Inc.
